title: Legend interaction parity and lightweight tooltips for dense time-series grids
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Deliver a unified interaction model for legends and tooltips across time-series components (single charts, small multiples, and heatmap timelines) that meets keyboard/AT requirements and reduces rendering cost for high-cardinality series. Scope includes: (1) legend affordances (hover, focus, keyboard toggle, compact mode for >8 series); (2) an ultra-light tooltip variant for dense views that exposes only primary datapoint + delta; (3) accessibility semantics (ARIA roles, focus management, screen reader phrasing); (4) performance patterns (canvas rendering fallback, progressive downsampling, memoized layout).

Background: Multiple product teams built ad-hoc legend/tooltip patterns that diverge in interactions and create inconsistent support burden for keyboard/AT and mobile. On 2026-02-18 the Observability team reported a 3x latency regression when charts display >200 series in a single dashboard. This ticket unifies the design spec and hands off clear acceptance criteria to engineering.

Outcomes:
- Single canonical interaction spec for desktop, tablet, and mobile accessible legends.
- Lightweight tooltip design to use in small-multiples and dashboard tiles.
- Performance recommendations document (implementation pairing with runtime/infra team).
- QA checklist for AT coverage and stress testing on 100/500/2000 series workloads.
